title: MoHUA Approves Operational Guidelines for ₹9,585 Crore 'PARIVARTAN Scheme'
summary: Accelerates replacement of polluting NCR trucks and buses with BS-VI or electric vehicles.

blocks.content: Accelerates replacement of polluting NCR trucks and buses with BS-VI or electric vehicles.

items: Outlay & Central Support: ₹9,585 crore total outlay including ₹5,041 crore central budgetary support.
Incentive Package: Motor vehicle tax waivers, 5% interest subvention on vehicle loans, min 8% OEM discount, and Certificate of Deposit (CoD) trading.
